verdict.rationale: Sardine's own marketing describes in-product AI agents that perform supporting research on sanctions matches, route higher-risk matches to analysts, and speed up KYC/AML alert reviews. That is a form of AI-generated analysis surfaced inside the product, but it is limited to compliance alert triage, not general insights or suggestions over a user's data. Missing for 10: general AI insights or suggestions across customer data, documentation of what the agents produce and how users see it in the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research, and route higher-risk matches for analyst review.
Agentic AML Ops: Automate KYC/AML alert reviews and speed up investigations with audit-ready agents.
Auto-clear low-risk matches and escalate real exposure with explainable scores.
